sections.heading: Tenses beyond time
sections.body:
At C1 you'll meet tenses used for style or attitude rather than time:

- **Historical present** — the present for past events, to make a story vivid (history books, anecdotes): *Colón llega a América en 1492.* *Ayer voy por la calle y de repente me encuentro a Pedro.* (Yesterday I'm walking down the street and suddenly I run into Pedro.)
- **Imperfect of politeness** — the imperfect to soften a request or question: *Quería pedirle un favor.* (I wanted to ask you a favor.) *¿Qué deseaba?* (What would you like? — in shops)
- **Imperfect in children's play / dreams**: *Yo era el policía y tú eras el ladrón.* (I'll be the cop and you be the robber.) *Soñé que volaba.*

sections.heading: The conditional of rumour
sections.body: In journalism, the conditional presents unconfirmed information — "reportedly": *Según fuentes oficiales, el presidente habría renunciado.* (According to official sources, the president has reportedly resigned.) *El sospechoso estaría escondido en el norte del país.* (The suspect is believed to be hiding in the north.) Style guides dislike it, but it's everywhere in the news.

sections.heading: The future of concession and surprise
sections.body:
The future can concede a point before a *pero*: *Será muy inteligente, pero no sabe trabajar en equipo.* (He may be very smart, but he can't work in a team.) *Tendrá mucho dinero, pero no es feliz.*

It can also express surprise or indignation in exclamations and questions: *¡Será posible!* (Can you believe it!) *¿Serás capaz de irte sin despedirte?* (Would you really leave without saying goodbye?)

Yesterday I'm walking down the street and suddenly I run into Pedro.
Quería pedirle un favor.
I wanted to ask you a favor.
¿Qué deseaba?
What would you like?
Venía a preguntar por el departamento.
I've come to ask about the apartment.
Yo era el policía y tú eras el ladrón.
I'll be the cop and you be the robber.
Soñé que volaba.
I dreamed I was flying.
Según fuentes oficiales, el presidente habría renunciado.
According to official sources, the president has reportedly resigned.
El sospechoso estaría escondido en el norte del país.
The suspect is believed to be hiding in the north of the country.
El incendio habría sido provocado.
The fire was allegedly started deliberately.
Será muy inteligente, pero no sabe trabajar en equipo.
He may be very smart, but he can't work in a team.
Tendrá mucho dinero, pero no es feliz.
He may have a lot of money, but he's not happy.

Can you believe it!
¿Serás capaz de irte sin despedirte?
Would you really leave without saying goodbye?

He may well have studied a lot, but he failed.
